verdict.rationale: Unit is an API-first platform: the evidence says teams can build directly on its APIs, use the APIs to reach customer, account, payment and card data, and receive webhook events. That makes programmatic, headless operation possible. However, nothing documents CI or automation workflows, and probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: CLI or CI tooling, sandbox/test-environment docs, headless authentication (API tokens) docs, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
